counting: worker threads, excluding the coordinating main thread; ignore walkers run in a separate phase
shared_pool_scope: Full index builds walk on the caller, then extraction lanes and sorting share one Rayon pool. Thus full builds use 4 or 6 Rayon worker threads plus the coordinating main thread. Incremental and cached-tree walks are not changed by this isolated prototype.

async_pool.scheduling: one in-flight chunk task per lane on a shared Rayon pool; collector immediately resubmits completed lanes; the main thread stays outside the pool; no worker blocks on channel send
